result_text:
Archived orders no longer appear in the latest orders overall, by region or by customer. The full offline test suite passes. I didn't add a test for your Alpha/Beta example or run it separately.

The change is in `DataStore.java`, in `findLatestOrders`, `findLatestOrdersByRegion` and `findLatestOrdersByCustomer`. Each query now has the same `AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_archive ar WHERE ar.order_id = o.id)` condition that the other order queries use to skip archived orders.

I didn't update the javadoc on those three methods. It still says only cancelled orders are left out, because the command that would have edited it needed approval and I skipped it.
